papers.title: Beach bar tab
lines: The Soggy Dollar Bar: you swim ashore with your cash, and the notes are hung out to dry.
The Painkiller, they say, was invented here. I had three. I stand by that.

papers.title: Charter logbook
lines: Day one: anchored at a cove. Day two: anchored at a different cove. Day three: reanchored for no reason.
The crew says it is the best week of their lives. The skipper says it is Tuesday.

trail.clue: A skipper hid a coin purse near the open ground 'in case the rum runs out'.

papers.title: After-the-storm note
lines: The roof went, the boat went, the neighbours came. Everybody shared what was left.
We rebuilt. We always rebuild. The coconut tree was the first to grow back.

papers.title: Pirate legend
lines: Blackbeard marooned fifteen men on a rock, with a bottle of rum each. Hence the rhyme.
The rhyme is not accurate. The rock is very real. The rum has long since gone.
